origin: Authored locally and exported with LTspice for the M1 encoding spike
author: xdylanm
notes: Exported with LTspice 26.1.1.0. encoding_cp1252.asc is cp1252, and encoding_utf8.asc is UTF-8 because Omega (U+03A9) is not representable in cp1252. Both exported .net files are UTF-8 without a BOM. The cp1252 schematic's micro sign (U+00B5) and degree sign (U+00B0) are preserved; UTF-8 input is interpreted as Windows-1252, producing mojibake in the exported netlist. Absolute source-path comments were normalized to relative filenames.
